title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Science - Biology - Cell Biology
subject: General Science

questions.q: The process of swelling or shrinking in plant cells, which leads to changes in shape and movement, is directly caused by which factor?
options: Change in the amount of water inside them.
questions.explain: Plant cells change their shape by changing the amount of water in them (turgor pressure), resulting in swelling or shrinking.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: Which of the following examples best explains the role of lysosome activity in our daily life?
options: White blood cells engulfing and destroying harmful bacteria
A green leaf making food through photosynthesis
A nerve cell sending a signal to help feel pain
A red blood cell supplying oxygen to muscles
questions.explain: Lysosomes are organelles that contain powerful digestive enzymes capable of breaking down organic materials. When a white blood cell engulfs a bacterium (phagocytosis), its lysosomes digest and destroy the pathogen.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: What is the main function of the nucleus in an eukaryotic cell?
options: Acting as a storage unit for food
Directing life processes of the cell
questions.explain: The nucleus is the control center of an eukaryotic cell. It contains the cell's genetic material (DNA) and directs all cellular activities and life processes, including growth, metabolism, and reproduction.
